hints.title: Positional Digit Contribution
hints.text: Compute the number of times digit one appears at each place value (ones, tens, hundreds) independently.

hints.title: Higher and Lower Partitions around Digit
hints.text: For place value m, decompose n into higher = n // (m * 10), cur = (n // m) % 10, and lower = n % m.

hints.title: Place Value Formula
hints.text: At place value m: if cur == 0, count += higher * m. If cur == 1, count += higher * m + lower + 1. If cur > 1, count += (higher + 1) * m. Iterate m by multiplying by 10 until m exceeds n.

complexity.notes: Optimal digit counting running in 10 iterations for 32-bit integers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating from 1 to N takes O(N) which times out for N up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mathematical place-value decomposition evaluates in O(log10(N)) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Partition each digit place into higher, current, and lower segments.
